description: Enable or disable automatic wallet top-ups. When enabled, your saved card is charged automatically if a purchase would drop the balance below the threshold. Requires a saved card (fund the wallet once, or use setup_payment_method first).

recharge_amount_cents.description: Amount to recharge each time (integer cents)

threshold_cents.description: Recharge when the balance would drop below this (integer cents)

name: configure_auto_recharge
